summary: The comments emphasize the importance of the E-Rate program for school districts, libraries, and students, arguing against any restrictions or sunset of the program. The comments highlight the financial burden and impact on educational priorities if the program were to be eliminated or significantly altered. The comments also stress the need for local educators to make decisions about technology use and internet safety, rather than federal regulations.
